articles.title: A new Islamic defense axis? Why India is watching the Badr accord closely
articles.summary: Türkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia recently signed the ‘Badr’ defense cooperation accord in Doha. This strategic agreement, signed on October 21, aims to significantly deepen their defense industry collaboration, reflecting a growing alignment among these nations. The accord seeks to enhance military capabilities and foster regional security through joint development and production, highlighting evolving geopolitical partnerships and defence self-reliance for an SSB aspirant.

articles.title: Indian Navy Rescues Hijacked Fishing Vessel Azini Off Somalia Coast, Frees 20 Crew Members
articles.summary: The Indian Navy successfully rescued the fishing vessel Azini from armed pirates off Somalia after a 48-hour coordinated operation. All crew members were secured, and control of the vessel was restored. This anti-piracy mission demonstrates the Indian Navy's strong commitment to maritime security and its expanding capability to safeguard vital international shipping lanes, a significant role for defence aspirants to observe.
